description: Marriott International, Inc. is a worldwide franchisor, operator and licensor of hotel, residential, timeshare and other lodging properties under a portfolio of compelling brands at different price and service points, and consistent with its focus on franchising, management and licensing it owns or leases very few of its lodging properties, less than one percent of its system. As of year-end 2025 its system included 9,805 properties comprising 1,779,936 rooms in 145 countries and territories, and it also had approximately 4,100 properties, nearly 610,000 rooms, in its development pipeline, and it discusses its operations in the following reportable business segments: U.S. & Canada, Europe, Middle East & Africa, Greater China, and Asia Pacific excluding China, with its Caribbean & Latin America operating segment not meeting the applicable accounting criteria for separate disclosure as a reportable business segment and its results included in Unallocated corporate and other.
